messages.content: 你能提供籃球運動員勒布朗·詹姆斯目前的統計數據嗎？具體包括他的得分、助攻、籃板和上場時間？然後，也能請你提供洛杉磯湖人隊目前的統計數據嗎？包括他們的總得分、總助攻、總籃板和勝率？之後，你能給我洛杉磯湖人隊和金州勇士隊在2021年1月18日比賽的詳細統計數據嗎？包括總得分、總助攻、總籃板和失誤數？

message.reasoning:
The user wants stats:

1) LeBron James current stats: points, assists, rebounds, minutes.

We need to call basketball_player_stats_get with player_name "LeBron James" and stats_fields ["points", "assists", "rebounds", "minutes"].

2) Los Angeles Lakers current stats: total points, total assists, total rebounds, win rate.

Call basketball_team_stats_get with team_name "Los Angeles Lakers" and stats_fields ["total_points","total_assists","total_rebounds","win_rate"]

3) Game between LA Lakers vs Golden State Warriors on Jan 18, 2021. Provide total points, total assists, total rebounds, turnovers (the user said turnovers? Actually they wrote "失误数"? They want turnovers). So we need to get stats fields ["total_points","total_assists","total_rebounds","turnovers"]. Use basketball_game_stats_get with team1="Los Angeles Lakers", team2="Golden State Warriors", date="2021-01-18".

We'll produce calls accordingly.
